name: pro-testing
description: The Verify phase: native Vitest (unit/component), agent-browser (interactive verification), and Storybook interactions, plus qa-suite — a bridge to the petrkindlmann/qa-skills library installed on demand via the /qa-engine command (npx skills add): qa-do/qa-start routers, playwright-automation, visual-testing, api/contract-testing, test-reliability, and QA strategy/risk/planning. Playwright is provided on demand via the qa-suite bridge (/qa-engine), not as a hard plugin dependency.
